paragraphs: Videray Technologies, founded in 2018 by a group of engineers in Boston, Massachusetts, develops non-intrusive inspection and imaging technology. Its home page describes what it makes as a portable handheld backscatter X-ray imager. The buyers it names are law enforcement officials who face criminal techniques while performing their duties in the field.

The company attributes image depth to 140 keV of power and its optics, which it says allow seeing through more material. The product is called the PX1, and Videray credits it with advanced image processing and image clarity. Portability and connectivity are presented as ways to speed up inspection, allowing quick scans and dispositioning of potential threats.

Videray positions the system for mission-critical imaging work where the overall system footprint or the scan standoff distance may be constrained. Paul Bradshaw is the chief executive officer. Headquarters are at 529 Main Street, Suite 100, Charlestown, MA 02129.

quote.text: Videray is a proud American company formed to disrupt the market with its advanced non-intrusive inspection and imaging technologies deployed worldwide.
